messages:
Sam: Heads-up prepping Voltix QBR next Thurs. Onboarding stuck at stage 2; embed-heavy workflows causing spikes. Need: final 30d forecast, alert plan for renewal owner, and a short enablement offer we can surface during the QBR. Thoughts?

Priya: I'll pull token mix now. Quick note: their embeds are ~55% of calls but consume disproportionate compute due to vector dims. Will drop numbers in 10m.

billing-bot: NOTICE: Voltix usage reached 62% of monthly retainer. Thresholds: 60/80/95.

Luca: For the QBR pitch, two pragmatic levers: (A) batching + request-level dedup for embeddings, (B) temporary 2-week commit at 20% discount to secure renewal conversation. Both short-term reduce runway risk.

Priya: Numbers pasted: ```
7d avg tokens/day: 780,000
30d avg tokens/day: 520,000
Embed ops/day: 18,500
Retainer size: $9,000/month
Projected 30d spend (status quo): $11,200
Projected 30d spend (with batching + dedup): $8,900
Projected 30d spend (with quantized model + enablement): $7,700
Days to hit retainer at current pace: 14
```
Link to sheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/voltix-qbr-runbook

Nadia: I can run a 45-min enablement session: agenda = 10m overview, 20m tuning + batching lab, 15m rollout checklist. Deliverable = playbook + sample scripts. Quick sample dedup snippet: ```
embed.dedup.enabled = true
embed.dedup.threshold = 0.92
embed.batch.size = 128
```

Sam: Good. We need a crisp set of options for the CSM to propose on the call: 1) free 1-hour workshop + playbook, 2) 2-week discounted commit ($1.8k) to buy time, 3) auto-throttle rules and alerting. Who owns which?

Luca: I'll draft the discounted commit language and quick ROI slide (net new cost per active user). Recommend we only show commit if they indicate concern at 80% threshold.

Priya: I'll update the forecast tab with the three scenarios and add a chart comparing embed vs gen ops. Also adding a sensitivity line for embed dimensionality (e.g., 1024 -> 768 dims).

cs-bot: ACTION: Voltix QBR prep checklist created and assigned to Sam, Priya, Nadia. Deadline: 48h.

Nadia: Also recommend we offer a one-time T&S (tuning & scripts) package: 3 quick wins - reduce embed dim where safe, enable batching, add caching layer. Expected improvement: 20-35% on embed cost depending on fidelity needs.

Sam: Owners: Priya -> forecast + sheet; Luca -> commit wording + ROI slide; Nadia -> workshop + playbook; Sam -> QBR deck + renewal ask. I'll call a 30-min dry run Wed 9am.

Priya: Confirming. I'll include a small table of alert messaging copy for 60/80/95%. Example: 80% = "Voltix: You've reached 80% of monthly credits. Recommend booking enablement to avoid throttling."

Luca: One last bit: if they decline commit and continue at current pace, propose auto-suggest: system recommends a short top-up credit purchase modal (pre-approved CS offer) in-app. We'll mock the UI for the QBR.

Sam: Perfect. Please push final numbers and slides by EOD Wed so I can finalize the talk track before the dry run. Thanks team :rocket:
